risk_factors.heading: Debt covenant compliance and ability to service debt
risk_factors.quote: If there were an event of default under any of our debt instruments that was not cured or waived, the holders of the defaulted debt could terminate commitments to lend and cause all amounts outstanding with respect to the debt to be due and payable immediately

risk_factors.heading: Credit rating changes affect borrowing capacity and costs
risk_factors.quote: Actual or anticipated changes or downgrades in our credit ratings, including any announcement that our ratings are under further review for a downgrade, could affect our market value and/or increase our corporate borrowing costs.

risk_factors.heading: Common stock price volatility
risk_factors.quote: The market price of our common stock is likely to continue to be volatile and subject to significant price and volume fluctuations for many reasons

risk_factors.heading: Fluctuations in stock repurchases
risk_factors.quote: The amount, timing, and execution of our stock repurchases may fluctuate based on our priorities for the use of cash for other purposes

risk_factors.heading: No assurance of continued cash dividends
risk_factors.quote: There can be no assurance that we will declare cash dividends in the future in any particular amounts, or at all.

risk_factors.heading: Defined benefit pension liabilities and costs
risk_factors.quote: Negative performance of the financial markets could also have a material impact on funding requirements and net periodic pension costs. Our defined benefit pension plans may also be subject to demographic trends.

risk_factors.heading: Changes to Dutch, U.S. and foreign tax laws
risk_factors.quote: the EU has adopted a directive on ensuring a global minimum level of taxation for multinational companies, also known as Pillar 2, which became effective in 2024.

risk_factors.heading: Tax uncertainties including transfer pricing disputes
risk_factors.quote: Transfer pricing uncertainties can also result from disputes with local tax authorities about transfer pricing of internal deliveries of goods and services or related to financing, acquisitions and divestments
